name: How do I maintain and clean bathroom tile and grout?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain and clean bathroom tile and grout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining bathroom tile and grout involves regular cleaning with mild, pH-neutral cleaners to prevent soap scum and mildew buildup. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive scrubbers, especially on natural stone or glazed tiles, as these can damage the surface or sealant. For grout, consider using a specific grout cleaner and a soft brush to remove grime. Sealing grout lines, especially in showers, can significantly reduce staining and make cleaning easier. For natural stone, regular re-sealing is essential to maintain its protective barrier.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean bathroom tile and grout regularly with mild, pH-neutral cleaners; avoid harsh chemicals. Seal grout lines and natural stone to prevent stains and damage.
